parameter_sources.initialization: MOESM1 Forward Simulation: one cell at origin, n-1 iterations of division/growth/mechanical relaxation
parameter_sources.adhesion_experiment: MOESM1 Chemical Regulation of Cellular Adhesion: 3D, 50 time steps, 200 Brownian relaxation steps, no division after initialization
parameter_sources.core_shell_loss: MOESM1 core-shell loss equation: target radii 1/2/3; using first two radii for two-type setup
parameter_sources.target_j: Visible [J_AA, J_AB, J_BB]; internally adapted to the species Morse matrix expected by JAX-Morph
parameter_sources.model_overrides: Only epsilon scaling 0.8-3.8 and Brownian relaxation_steps=200 are passed because they differ from stock JAX-Morph defaults and are specified for the adhesion experiment
parameter_sources.model_defaults: alpha, r_onset, r_cutoff, and Brownian dt/kT/gamma use stock JAX-Morph defaults unless the adhesion experiment specifies otherwise
